articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: More Americans Have Tried Crypto, But Few Are Sticking With It: Survey
articles.description: A survey conducted by Ipsos for the DeFi Education Fund found that 22% of Americans have ever owned or used crypto, up from 18%, while past-year use held flat at 13%.

articles.title: OpenAI Plans to Buy Google's AI Chips as It Looks Beyond Nvidia: Report
articles.description: OpenAI, one of Nvidia's biggest customers, reportedly plans to buy Google's TPU chips. Neither company has confirmed the report, and the price and size of the order were not disclosed.

articles.title: Sam Bankman-Fried wrote to actor portraying him in Netflix series
articles.description: The former FTX CEO remains incarcerated as Irish actor Anthony Boyle portrays him in a series about the downfall of the crypto exchange and his relationship with Caroline Ellison.

articles.title: CFTC chief poses questions about policing AI but calls it a road to 'autonomous trading'
articles.description: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission held a forum in which the chairman, Mike Selig, suggested AI agents may usher in a financial revolution.

articles.title: Fed Stands Pat, Bitcoin Holds Steady—But a December Rate Hike Is in Play
articles.description: The Federal Reserve left rates unchanged Wednesday in a 10-2 vote, with Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack favoring a hike.

articles.title: Crypto isn’t a partisan fight, proven by data
articles.description: Treating crypto as a political battleground only makes it harder to build the secure, transparent, American-made financial system that most Americans say they want, argues DeFi Education Fund’s Jennifer Rosenthal.

articles.title: Strategy shareholders approve daily dividends for four preferred stocks
articles.description: The largest Bitcoin treasury company will begin daily dividend payments on STRC in November, with three other preferred securities following in January 2027.

articles.title: Fed leaves interest rates unchanged, as expected
articles.description: A rate hike in December remains likely as the U.S. central bank continues to focus on inflation, which remains well above its 2% target.

articles.title: AI Can Quietly Influence Experts’ Decisions, Anthropic Study Finds
articles.description: Professional analysts went along with their AI agent’s hidden opinion 86% of the time, and few credited it.

articles.title: Crypto PAC spending before midterms possibly obscured after reported FEC hack
articles.description: The FEC reported an “electronic filing system outage” on Tuesday as groups are expected to ramp up spending before the US midterm elections.

articles.title: Strategy Shareholders Approve Daily Dividends on Preferred Stock, With 99.3% in Favor
articles.description: STRC will begin paying dividends for every calendar day from November, with STRF, STRK and STRD following in January.

articles.title: Coinbase earnings: Wall Street divided on trading rebound after Robinhood crypto revenue sinks 55%
articles.description: Coinbase faces a key earnings test as analysts debate the strength of its trading rebound following a sharp drop in Robinhood's crypto revenue.

articles.title: Bitcoin price bounce rejected at 50-day trend line ahead of FOMC, earnings
articles.description: Bitcoin failed to move past its 50-day simple moving average as market participants awaited the outcome of the FOMC meeting and key tech earnings.

articles.title: Phantom launches Kalshi-powered prediction markets for US users
articles.description: The crypto wallet’s new integration offers CFTC-regulated event contracts through Kalshi, as prediction markets face growing legal challenges in the US.

articles.title: Aptos Advisor Leaves Post, Moves Meme-Fueled Campaign to Meta Stock
articles.description: Former Aptos advisor "Buzz” has left the crypto project and is turning his attention to Facebook's parent company Meta—here's why.

articles.title: Wall Street’s Fast Money Fled Bitcoin ETFs, Sovereign Funds Stepped In
articles.description: Galaxy Research found that nine hedge funds and banks cut 68,000 BTC worth of spot ETF exposure as the cash-and-carry trade dried up, while wealth platforms and sovereign funds added.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: What happens when an AI agent pays for the wrong thing
articles.description: The largest card networks now sit in the top governance tier of x402, the standard that AI agents use to pay for things online. Albert Castellana of GenLayer Labs explains why that standard has no way to dispute a charge, and what happens when the payment settles but the agent receives something wrong or useless.

articles.title: Fed Rate Decision: What Markets and Bitcoin Traders Can Expect
articles.description: The Federal Reserve decides today at 2 p.m. ET and traders see a hold as near certain. Here's what it means for Bitcoin and stock markets.

articles.title: JPMorgan, Coca-Cola Among 7 More Companies Objecting to OKX-ICE Tokenized Stocks
articles.description: Seven more companies, including JPMorgan Chase, Coca-Cola and Dell, have objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 33.

articles.title: Google Cloud outlines MPC service for institutional Bitcoin custody
articles.description: Google Cloud has detailed its preview MPC service for institutional Bitcoin custody as it holds a New York symposium focused on digital asset security.

articles.title: House Oversight Chair Comer Probes Delaware Plan for AI-Run Companies
articles.description: James Comer warned the proposed "AIC" could shield AI firms from liability, and asked Delaware's governor for documents by November 9.

articles.title: Cybersecurity’s Black October: How to protect yourself
articles.description: Each day brings news of another AI-powered attack, or a newly discovered vulnerability. Here’s what’s happening and how ordinary people can protect themselves online.

articles.title: DTCC unit launches tokenization services

articles.title: Goldman, BlackRock Alumni Raise $4 Million to Put Farm and Apartment Loans Onchain

articles.title: JPMorgan, Coca-Cola, Dell also say 'no' to OKX-ICE tokenized stock trading plan

articles.title: Bithumb Says Hackers Accessed Internal System, Leaking Personal Data

articles.title: Coinbase Customer Data Hit in Analytics Vendor Breach, Funds ‘Not Impacted’

articles.title: Brazil’s largest lender becomes first bank to formalize crypto brokerage under new rules

articles.title: Here's how much bitcoin and the S&P 500 could rally after midterms

articles.title: Securitize adds Stellar blockchain as institutional tokenization gathers steam

articles.title: Intel, Oracle, IBM join growing list of firms objecting to OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
articles.description: The latest notice added four objections, bringing the total to 26 as the joint venture prepares to test the SEC’s new framework for blockchain-based stock trading.

articles.title: Majority of Americans want candidates who support US-based financial technology: Poll

articles.title: OpenAI Proves ETH Is False, and Crypto Twitter Has Questions

articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra, Its Half-Good AI Model at Half the Price
articles.description: OpenAI's mid-tier model now operates apps and screens more like a person would, with API prices 50% below GPT-5.6 Terra and an error rate that OpenAI says fell sharply.

articles.title: Unitree Stock Jumps as Investors Bet Chatbot AI Will Finally Give Robots a Brain
articles.description: Unitree's shares have jumped about 60% in under two weeks as investors bet OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra will give robots the brains they lack, turning the stock into an AI proxy.
